prose.subject: Gentle Reminder: Invoice INV-95585
prose.body:
Hi Bramblecote Studio team,

Hope your week is going well! Just popping in with a friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-95585 for 3805.63 USDC. We haven’t received payment yet, and we want to make sure everything is on track on our end.

To process this, please send the funds to our standard vendor address: 0xa72486a4c2e48cdd0521816f37ac2817acfbd929. This is the same wallet we’ve used for previous transactions, so you can feel confident it’s the correct destination.

If you’ve already sent this, please disregard this note or let us know so we can update our records. If you need a copy of the invoice or any further details, just reply to this email and we’ll get it to you right away.

Thanks for your help, and looking forward to continuing our great collaboration!

Best regards,
Quillon Analytics Billing Team
